title: Flagged for review - irregularities and unverified values
policy: Flagged items never block publication. Each carries what was seen, why it is flagged, and the official link a reviewer needs.

rows.item: No market price exists anywhere in the repository or on the official pages
rows.detail: Every ROI, CLV and residual column is therefore blank. Earlier namespaces filled the same gap with an ASSUMED -110. That value is not a market price and is not used here.

rows.item: The committed 137-game feed was missing 12 of the 13 Week-10 finals
rows.detail: It held weeks 1-9 (136 games) plus one Week-10 game. The official Week-10 page shows 13 finals. The 13th, LAC at BAL, had not been played at read time.
rows.status: flagged, then fixed in this corpus

rows.item: The brief's '136-game log' is a weeks-1-9 log, not a season log
rows.detail: At this point in the season 149 games have been played. A backtest announced as being on 'the 136-game log' would silently omit Week 10.

rows.item: The availability ablation the brief asks for cannot be run on the data the repository holds
rows.detail: One dated availability snapshot exists for this season. An ablation needs the same model with and without the feature over many weeks.

rows.item: Absence from the injury report does not mean available
rows.detail: The November reserve list holds 27 Reserve/Injured moves, including Malik Willis (MIA, 11/10) and TreVeyon Henderson (NE, 11/14), neither of whom appears on the weekly report.

rows.item: Only 8 of the clubs on the Week-10 report were re-read this session
rows.detail: 96 rows were compared field by field and all 96 agreed with the committed capture. The other clubs were not re-read and are not claimed as verified.

rows.item: No official depth chart and no official snap-count table were found
rows.detail: Without either, the 2nd/3rd/4th-string requirement (R24, R38) and the matchup matrix (R38) cannot be produced without invention. Every depth column on this site is blank with this reason.

rows.item: One availability snapshot is a level, not a series
rows.detail: The brief asks for a surprise (observed minus expected). With one snapshot there is no expected. All 347 surprise values are blank.

rows.item: The published Week-11 schedule page does not date itself, and the file does not claim it does
rows.detail: The committed slate file has no capture timestamp in its own header. The schedule is transcribed here with 2026-11-17 as the read date, which is when this session read it.

rows.item: The official schedule page states stadiums only inside hotel deep-links
rows.detail: For example 'Highmark Stadium' appears in a Marriott URL parameter, not in a titled field. A URL parameter is not a statement, so those venues are left blank rather than scraped out of a link.

rows.item: Two namespaces publish the same 137-row results feed independently
rows.detail: They agree game for game today, which is why the corpus could be reconciled at all. Two owners of one fact is still a divergence risk.

rows.item: A first version of this session's own audit reported 2 namespaces publishing localhost references
rows.detail: On inspection both were prose asserting that there are none. The detector now matches a runtime reference, and the false positive is recorded here rather than deleted.

rows.item: The baseline's skill is measured against a home-rate benchmark, not against a market
rows.detail: A Brier Skill Score above a home-rate benchmark says the model beats a naive prior. It does not say the model beats a closing line, and with no price it cannot.

rows.item: Rest days for BAL and LAC changed once the scheduled-but-unplayed Week-10 game was counted
rows.detail: BAL first computed as 17 days of rest because its unplayed Monday game is not in the corpus. Counting scheduled fixtures gives 6. The rule is now in the artefact.
